propositions: rebar verify-commit-ticket fails with 'ticket store not found' in a fresh linked worktree because the pure intercept dispatch path skips the centralized store mount
store mount logic is currently replicated per dispatch arm and omitted entirely by pure intercepts, creating a structural risk that store-touching commands can bypass initialization
mount (ensure_initialized with init_only=True) must run at a single central CLI choke point before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch to guarantee all store-touching commands are initialized
commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure read-only commands) must not be force-mounted and must continue working without a store
REBAR_TRACKER_DIR environment variable override must still short-circuit the mount gate to preserve test and embedding behavior
